answer_1.quote: ...benchmarks for automated generation of natural language (NL) review comments ...

answer_2.quote: We pick commonly used reference‑based metrics for code review ... BLEU ... ROUGE‑L ... BERTScore ... Normalized Edit Distance ... chrF ... chrF++ ...

answer_3.quote: We develop an LLM prompting‑based approach that compares the model‑generated reviews against CodeReviewer references to generate relevance scores ... We prompt them with descriptions of the same Con, Comp, and Rel dimensions.

answer_4.quote: We had two trained human annotators (co‑authors of this paper) judge the quality of the pseudo‑references ... We gather annotations from the same annotators on reviews generated by 9 systems ... Raters assign a score on a Likert scale of 1 to 5 to each review for each dimension.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each review on a 5‑point Likert scale for conciseness, comprehensiveness, and relevance using the provided pseudo‑references as a basis.
